records.title: ADR-005: Salary Calculation Ownership
records.preview: # ADR-005: Salary Calculation Ownership ## Status Accepted — 2026-03-08 ## Context Salary/pension calculation exists in both services: - **Node gateway**: `GET /api/salary` (lookup), `GET /api/salary/meta`, `POST /api/salary/calc` — uses 303 pre-loaded salary entries, rank metadata, allowance tables. Full v4 pension calculator with family/medals modifiers. - **Python backend**: `POST /api/v2/salary/compute` — separate computation endpoint. - **Node also proxies** `/api/v2/salary/compute` → Python. The Node implementation is more complete (v4 calculator with all modifiers). records.title: ADR-006: Cases & Tickets Ownership
records.preview: # ADR-006: Cases & Tickets Ownership ## Status Accepted — 2026-03-08 ## Context Both services implement cases/tickets: - **Node gateway**: `/api/cases` CRUD (4 routes) — uses in-memory pluginDb (better-sqlite3/in-memory). Full lifecycle: create, list, update status/checklist, delete. - **Python backend**: `/api/v1/cases/*` (3 routes) — placeholder implementation (create, status, recent). Also `/api/v2/tickets` CRUD (4 routes) — support tickets with assignment and status tracking. The Node implementation is more mature for user-facing cases. Python tickets serve a different purpose (support/escalation workflow tied to KB feedback). ## Decision **Split by purpose:** | Feature | Owner | Reason | |---------|-------|--------| | User case files | **Node** | In-memory → planned PostgreSQL migration; user-facing CRUD | | Support tickets (v2) | **Python** | Tied to KB feedback resolution workflow

records.preview: /** * UTF-8 / Mojibake repair utilities for Arabic text. * Shared across ChatMessageView, UserWindow, VoiceMode, etc. */ export function countArabic(text: string): number { const matches = text.match(/[\u0600-\u06FF]/g); return matches ? matches.length : 0; } /** * Attempt to repair mojibake (UTF-8 bytes misinterpreted as Latin-1). * Works by re-encoding the string as Latin-1 bytes and then decoding as UTF-8. * If the result contains more Arabic characters, it was likely mojibake. */ export function fixMojibake(text: string): string { if (!text) return text; try { const bytes = new Uint8Array([...text].map((ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))); const decoded = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(bytes); return countArabic(decoded) > countArabic(text) ? decoded : text; } catch { return text; } }

records.preview: # Taxi Driver Admin Review Checklist ## Identity - Full name is present. - Phone number is verified or queued for OTP verification. - WhatsApp number is verified or confirmed manually. ## Vehicle - Vehicle make/model/color are present. - Plate number is captured privately. - Public UI exposes only safe partial plate details. - Plate type is reviewed. ## Licensing and Safety - Taxi/public transport proof reviewed. - Vehicle registration reviewed. - Insurance reviewed where available. - Inspection reviewed where available. - Safety equipment declaration reviewed. ## Approval Decision Allowed statuses: - PENDING - APPROVED - REJECTED - SUSPENDED Admin must not approve a driver unless minimum identity, phone, vehicle, and licensing checks are complete. ## Public Visibility Only APPROVED drivers with AVAILABLE status can appear in user search results.

records.title: Watany Trusted Mobility / Taxi Feature Source of Truth
records.preview: # Watany Trusted Mobility / Taxi Feature Source of Truth ## Product position This is not a generic ride-hailing clone. It is a trusted mobility module for Watany users, especially retired military personnel and families. ## V1 rule Only admin-approved and verified taxi/public-transport drivers should appear to users. Private cars may submit an application, but they must remain hidden until reviewed and approved according to the project's legal/safety policy. ## User flow 1. User opens Taxi / Trusted Mobility. 2. User selects pickup location using LocationSelector. 3. User chooses Now or Reservation. 4. App shows approved available drivers in the selected area. 5. User can Call, WhatsApp, Reserve, or Report. ## Driver flow 1. Driver applies. 2. Driver submits phone, WhatsApp, vehicle, plate, license, and service area. 3. Admin reviews. 4. Approved driver can press: أنا متاح الآن. 5. Drive
